title: Isolated browser-run fixtures
responsibility: Resolves, creates and cleans per-run fixture locations and assigns browser-test ports.

inputs.name: e2eFixtures.env
inputs.description: Environment record used to resolve a run’s fixture paths; a truthy HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is required, and console and analytics overrides apply when present. Defaults to process.env.

inputs.name: freePorts.count
inputs.description: Number of loopback ports to sample; zero returns an empty array. The implementation does not validate other values as positive integers.

inputs.name: openE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Mutable environment record used to name or create a run and record its ports. Defaults to process.env; a supplied HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is retained, and existing named ports are left intact.

inputs.name: namedE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Environment record inspected for a truthy HARNESS_E2E_ROOT and a missing HARNESS_E2E_OWNER. Defaults to process.env.

inputs.name: closeE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Environment record whose run directories are removed only when HARNESS_E2E_OWNER equals this process’s PID and HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is set. Defaults to process.env.

outputs.name: e2eFixtures
outputs.description: Fixture locations for one run: its root, report, console, analytics and build directories, plus site(name) for a site checkout path. Console and analytics use their respective environment overrides when set; build is under the checkout cache keyed by the root basename.

outputs.name: freePorts
outputs.description: Array of numeric loopback ports that a child process briefly bound and then released. The ports are not reserved for later use.

outputs.name: openE2eRun
outputs.description: Fixture locations for the opened run. If HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is unset, it creates a temporary directory and marks this process as owner; it assigns and records free values for each unset port variable.

outputs.name: namedE2eRun
outputs.description: Boolean that is true only when HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is truthy and HARNESS_E2E_OWNER is unset.

outputs.name: closeE2eRun
outputs.description: Removes the run root and its frozen build-cache directory only when HARNESS_E2E_OWNER equals this process’s PID and HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is set; otherwise it returns without cleanup.

errors.name: Missing E2E run root or fixture setup failure
errors.description: Thrown when e2eFixtures has no truthy HARNESS_E2E_ROOT, or when filesystem or child-process operations fail.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown if freePorts cannot parse the child process’s port list as JSON.
